final: WITH c AS (SELECT category, AVG((spent - amount) * 1.0 / amount) AS avg_rel, COUNT(*) AS n FROM budget GROUP BY category), a AS (SELECT AVG(n) AS avg_n FROM c) SELECT AVG(c.avg_rel) AS avg_of_avg_rel_overspend, AVG(c.n) AS avg_line_count, AVG(c.n - a.avg_n) AS avg_excess FROM c, a WHERE c.n > a.avg_n
